column1: #mapping_set_description: refgenie 1.x server sequence table, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/genomes/{digest}/sequences (OpenAPI schema GenomeSequencesResponse). The adapter gives one record per element of 'sequences'; row fields use their own names (name, length, ...) and the collection fields (digest, n_sequences, total_length, level1.*, collection_aliases) are repeated on every row.

column9: Value transformed (map). Lossy: RefgetStore namespace 'name' becomes refmeta namespace 'refgenie'; other store namespaces pass through.
Lossy: The rest of the FASTA header line; structured tags inside (AC:, rl:) stay as text.
RefgetStore storage encoding (dna2bit, dnaio); a deployment detail.
